en-US.description: Easily install prebuilt binaries from GitHub.
en-US.longDescription: Eget is the best way to easily get pre-built binaries for your favorite tools. It downloads and extracts pre-built binaries from releases on GitHub. To use it, provide a repository and Eget will search through the assets from the latest release in an attempt to find a suitable prebuilt binary for your system. If one is found, the asset will be downloaded and Eget will extract the binary to the current directory. Eget should only be used for installing simple, static prebuilt binaries, where the extracted binary is all that is needed for installation. For more complex installation, you may use the --download-only option, and perform extraction manually.
en-US.name: Eget

zh-CN.description: 从 GitHub 轻松安装预编译二进制文件。
zh-CN.longDescription: Eget 是轻松获取你喜爱的工具的预编译二进制文件的最佳方式。它能从 GitHub 上的发布版本中下载并提取预置二进制文件。要使用它，只需提供一个版本库，Eget 就会从最新发布的版本中搜索资产，试图为你的系统找到合适的预编译二进制文件。如果找到了，Eget 就会下载资产，并将二进制文件解压缩到当前目录。Eget 只能用于安装简单、静态的预编译二进制文件。对于更复杂的安装，您可以使用 --download-only 选项，并手动执行解压缩。
